recon.notes: Platform: Next.js + Sanity CMS (image CDN cdn.sanity.io/images/5h0axiqb/production/…), server-rendered, so a static fetch sees the whole listing. Nothing on the site is a one-off right now: all 14 listed nights are isRecurring:true with a recurrence object (5 weekly, 9 monthly-by-ordinal-weekday), and the page materializes each into dated cards for roughly the next 90 days (weekly nights get 13 cards, monthly nights 3). The ?date= value on each card link is the occurrence date at the anchor document's time-of-day in UTC (e.g. undergear ?date=2026-09-19T14:46:00.000Z = 07:46 Pacific), NOT the door time — it shifts by one hour after the 2026-11-01 DST change (14:46Z → 15:46Z) and the calendar date in America/Los_Angeles is always the card's date. Door times are only in the "Doors 9PM" text / doorsTime field; end times only in the endTime field and description ("MIDNIGHT", "12AM", "2AM", "11:59pm"). ticketingUrl is null on every document, so no ticket links exist. Only the listing page was read; the 92 /events/<slug>?date= detail pages were not fetched.

coverage.basis: All counts come from the /events listing door (https://www.eagleportland.com/events, fetched 2026-09-19): 92 dated card links = 14 distinct event slugs, and the page's embedded Sanity documents give the same 14 _ids, every one isRecurring:true with a recurrence object, so published = 14 series (5 weekly: Slutty BBQ Cookout Sun, Brief Encounters Mon, Gaymenight Tue, Midweek Hump Karaoke Wed, Naked Pool Thu; 9 monthly: Undergear 3rd Sat, Growth 3rd Mon, The Locker Room last Fri, L.U.R.E 4th Sat, Leather Scotch & Cigar Social 1st Fri, Classic Cock 2nd Fri, Night Flight 2nd Sat, Sunday Showtunes 2nd Sun, AWOO! 3rd Fri; 5 x 13 cards + 9 x 3 cards = 92). Every one of the 92 card links is recorded as a listed occurrence; the listing horizon (2026-09-19..2026-12-18) is the occurrence window, so no rule-only occurrences were added. The collapsed "Archive (5 past events)" holds 5 past docs (Ruggercub 2026-09-05, Let Them Eat Cake 2026-08-04, Boots & Buzzcuts 2026-08-01, Wide Load 2026-08-01, L.U.R.E. — Leather, Uniform, Rubber, Etc. 2026-07-26) — counted here, enumerated only in the trap. Second door: the home page UPCOMING strip repeats the first four cards with identical dates and door times.

traps.label: "▶ Archive (5 past events)" toggle at the foot of /events
traps.why: The five archived documents are present only in the page's RSC payload (the toggle renders no cards and no links in the static HTML): Ruggercub (2026-09-05, "Saturday, September 5, 8PM"), Let Them Eat Cake (with Oregon Leather Pride) (2026-08-04), Boots & Buzzcuts (2026-08-01, IML weekend kickoff), Wide Load (2026-08-01 in its date field although its description says "Friday, August 31") and L.U.R.E. — Leather, Uniform, Rubber, Etc. (2026-07-26, the earlier one-off edition of the live L.U.R.E series). All five are past; the parser does not set allowPastEvents. Ruggercub is additionally saved as isRecurring:true with recurrence {"frequency":"monthly","weekday":"sat"} and no monthlyPosition, yet the site materializes no future card for it — a payload reader that trusts isRecurring would invent a monthly Ruggercub.
traps.note: The 5 docs have no dated card and no href on the listing; their only dates are the ISO "date" fields inside self.__next_f.push chunks. None of the five should appear in a run.

traps.label: "Saturday, August 22, 9PM, at Eagle Portland." inside the live L.U.R.E description
traps.why: The L.U.R.E series document (recurrence monthly / fourth / sat, cards on 2026-09-26, 10-24, 11-28) still carries its launch-night copy naming August 22. A reader that dates an event from description prose would emit a 2026-08-22 L.U.R.E — a past ghost that no card publishes. The card's own date box and ?date= link are the truth.
traps.note: The listing card shows only the truncated description ("Come dressed in your finest leather,…"); the full sentence is visible in the RSC payload and presumably on the detail page.

openQuestions.q: Naked Pool publishes three different start times: the card and doorsTime say "Doors 2PM", the description ends "Thursdays · 9PM", and the poster alt text says "Thursday 6PM pool tournament". This file uses 14:00 (the rendered Doors value); confirm which one the scraper should carry.

The cadence of every night is machine-stated only in the embedded Sanity "recurrence" object; 13 of 14 also say it in visible description prose, but L.U.R.E does not (its prose names a stale August 22). If the scraper may only write a recurrence it can quote from visible text, L.U.R.E stays three dated singles (2026-09-26, 10-24, 11-28) rather than one FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=4SA series.

Card links carry ?date=<ISO> at the anchor document's time-of-day (07:46 Pacific for Undergear), not the door time. A parser that reads that ISO as the start would be wrong by hours; the "Doors 9PM" text is the start. Worth a guard if the parser ever reads the link timestamp.
